description: A React component class 'SuperChart' that manages rendering of various chart types with support for dynamic sizing, error boundaries, and special modes like matrixify. It integrates multiple external libraries and internal components to provide a flexible chart rendering solution within the Superset project.

classes.name: SuperChart
classes.description: A React component class that renders charts with support for dynamic sizing, error handling, and matrixify mode.

methods.name: renderChart
methods.description: Renders the chart component with specified width and height, handling matrixify mode, no results, and error boundaries.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method that manages dynamic sizing and calls renderChart accordingly.

methods.name: setRef
methods.description: Sets the reference to the core chart component.

methods.name: getQueryCount
methods.description: Retrieves the number of queries expected for the current chart type.
